_comment: High or critical advisories accepted for DEV dependencies only, each with a reason and an expiry. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails on anything in a production dependency, on anything not listed here, and on expired entries.

advisories.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested brace patterns. Reached only through the Next.js ESLint plugin, which expands the repository's own fixed glob patterns at lint time; no untrusted input reaches it and it never ships. No fixed braces release exists (3.0.3 is the newest) and every @next/eslint-plugin-next release pins fast-glob 3.3.1.
